name: Pocket Wings 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Fly a small aircraft over six landscapes, for as long as you like. Turn the wheel to bank and turn; leave it and the wings level. Hold Prev to climb and Next to dive. Play steps through slow, cruise and fast. Select switches between the view from behind and the cockpit. The ground can't hurt you. Discovery shows the way to each landscape's five landmarks: fly low over one to find it.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel banks the aircraft, and the wings level when you stop. Thumb: rest your thumb right or left of the top of the wheel to bank that way.

options.name: height
options.title: Height
options.help: Hold height: the aircraft keeps its height above the water, and Prev and Next climb and dive. Follow the ground: it keeps a height above the ground, rising and sinking with the hills, and Prev and Next set that height.

options.name: engine
options.title: Engine sound
options.help: The engine's hum, higher the faster you fly.

options.name: picture
options.title: Picture
options.help: Auto: the picture steps up and down with what the iPod can draw smoothly. Fast: always the plainer picture at 25 frames a second. Detailed: always the finest, which an iPod Video playing music can't keep up with.

options.name: stats
options.title: Frame rate
options.help: Shows the picture's level (Q0 finest to Q4 plainest) and the frames a second.

achievements.name: explorer
achievements.title: Explorer
achievements.text: Find all five landmarks of one landscape.

achievements.name: worldtour
achievements.title: World Tour
achievements.text: Fly for a minute over every landscape.

achievements.name: ceiling
achievements.title: Cloud Nine
achievements.text: Climb as high as the aircraft goes.
